text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, sulfamethoxazole and trimethoprim 800 mg/160 mg tablets are not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 401 tablets with 14.9 tablets used daily, providing 26.9 days on hand. Corvale General holds 469 tablets with 15.9 tablets used daily, providing 29.5 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): The product label identifies NuCare Pharmaceuticals, Inc. as the labeler and a registered repack plant (FEI 3003294404) last inspected with NAI classification on 2025-03-12. FDA inspection records for that plant show multiple VAI classifications from 2010 through 2020 and a Warning Letter issued on 2019-09-27. The rule-based alternate manufacturer ranked first is Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, whose plant Amneal Pharmaceuticals Private Limited received an NAI classification on 2024-07-19.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately four weeks at both sites. No FDA shortage listing exists. The NuCare repack plant has a history of VAI findings and a 2019 Warning Letter, though its most recent inspection was NAI. Amneal’s plant received an NAI in July 2024.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer verifies current allocation status and pricing with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC; P&T committee approves addition to formulary if terms are acceptable.
2. Buyer confirms supply availability with Amneal Pharmaceuticals of New York LLC; P&T committee approves as secondary source.
3. Buyer evaluates Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC, Aurobindo Pharma Limited, and AvKARE for allocation and plant transparency; P&T committee approves any added sources.
4. Buyer monitors NuCare plant inspection history for future regulatory actions; reports changes to P&T committee.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time; those decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
